design_choices_not_fixed_by_the_design.teacher_coordinates: Teacher = other peer in eval mode; unaugmented inputs; centering by a <=128-sample same-modality batch mean of the same call (fit: P encoding chunk; apply: noisy batch captions / noisy batch observed images); l2norm. This costs three extra no-grad teacher forwards per t2i step (128 captions, 128 images, <=640 candidate images). The production C-native search keeps the native xt2 query (loader tokens, teacher val forward_emb); only the scorer uses the re-encoded coordinates. Q1 uses the same coordinates so that Q1 vs Q2-Q4 differ only by the scorer.
design_choices_not_fixed_by_the_design.P_threshold: teacher clean prob > teacher avg_clean_prob (= mean prob over the teacher's clean split), i.e. the host's high-confidence enqueue rule written with the teacher's own statistics (the host enqueue compares the loader prob with the CURRENT peer's avg_clean_prob; for the scorer the teacher's own value is used so that P depends only on the frozen teacher).
design_choices_not_fixed_by_the_design.P_size: random subset of <=16384 fit + <=2048 held-out pairs per stage (trial stage: 78447 available). Held-out pairs are diagnostics only.
design_choices_not_fixed_by_the_design.head_reinit: head refitted from scratch every stage with a stage seed shared by all arms (no warm start) -> no head state in checkpoints; resume refits the same stage.
design_choices_not_fixed_by_the_design.nce_form: soft-NCE = t2i in-batch competition over the P batch's images with logits 2g; soft targets spread over in-batch duplicates of the caption's observed image ID (training-visible). One-directional (application is t2i).
design_choices_not_fixed_by_the_design.link_scales: pre-link g shared: VCS T=tanh(g), BCE logit 2g, NCE logits 2g, so g estimates 0.5 log(p/q) for all three and one readout scale serves Q2-Q4.
design_choices_not_fixed_by_the_design.readout_and_steps: STEPS and the two beta values chosen once by pre-written rules (r27q_config.TRIAL_RULES) in the real-data technical trial 1078146 (gate start state, stage A, f40 noise): STEPS=200, BETA_HEAD=2.0 (pooled Q2-Q4 NLL; per-head argmin vcs 2, bce 2, snce 1 recorded as info), BETA_COS=16.0. Grids, architecture (hidden 256, 2049 inputs), LR 1e-3, batch 128, N_FIT/N_VAL were fixed before the trial.

observations_from_trial_info_only.snce_head_offset: the soft-NCE head drifts to large negative g (T=tanh(g) ~ -1, held-out J = -1) because NCE is invariant to a per-query shift; softmax readout over candidates is invariant to that shift. Not an error.
observations_from_trial_info_only.calibration_set_top1: on the trial calibration set (observed image + 4 cosine-nearest distractors) the observed top1 was cos 0.662, vcs 0.611, bce 0.605, snce 0.632 (heads are trained against the product of marginals, not against hard negatives). Recorded, not acted on.

uniform_gate: Two routes: (a) GATE_UNIFORM='mean': all Q computations run (stage fit, teacher scoring) and then the native alpha=None mean path is used -> must equal C-native bitwise (proves no side effect of the extra work, incl. RNG); (b) 'weighted': alpha = full 1/5 through the weighted pooling path -> sum_j 0.2*h_j vs mean(h) differ only by fp32 rounding (0.2 not exact); max diffs reported, pass within float tolerance.
